bases.name: The Borrowed Edge
bases.flavour: It remembers a hand that was never yours.

bases.name: Thunderfall
bases.flavour: It falls. Then comes the sound.

bases.name: The Slow Argument
bases.flavour: Settled, in the end, by weight.

bases.name: Needle of Weather
bases.flavour: It goes through, and keeps going.

bases.name: Coat of Small Mercies
bases.flavour: Stitched from what others left behind.

bases.name: Hood of the Held Breath
bases.flavour: Say nothing and it stays closed.

bases.name: Boots of the Short Road
bases.flavour: Every road is shorter in the dark.

bases.name: Ring of Static
bases.flavour: Warm to the touch. Never the same warm.

bases.name: The Counted Hours
bases.flavour: Spent, and still it adds up.

bases.name: The Door of Many Rooms
bases.flavour: Behind it, something is always knocking.
